result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best accounting software for a small business depends on where you operate, whether you have employees, and how complicated your bookkeeping is.

**My overall recommendation is Xero**, particularly if you're running a small business in Australia. It's easy to use, has excellent bank-feed automation, handles GST and BAS, and integrates with lots of other business tools.

Here are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best accounting software compared (2026)

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall for Australia)

- Easy to learn and use.
- Automatic bank feeds and reconciliation.
- GST, BAS and payroll features.
- Excellent accountant integration.

Best for most small businesses, including growing businesses.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for payroll and inventory)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features.
- Good for businesses with employees.
- Useful inventory and job-management options.

Best for businesses with more complex operations.

[Visit MYOB](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. QuickBooks**

- Good invoicing and expense tracking.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Lots of third-party integrations.

Best for businesses wanting broad accounting functionality.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---

![Zoho Books Logo PNG Vector (SVG) Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4BiXY_WEN49lYCvbGaKDFfpQRd4AylQLrJUAqECUlizaJxfPoT7vHE_aMf89Ai5XDgiicM083l1mRaYjiwKVUSU-hyO3RMNhHn9n_1p9iDfGlD90vd7yixEZXe3uN-cFk5rC7bm4cnrvTfOD__DTiLg0FqR-qg85e1e4wDVsY_7IdvAZqwAqO3vtJfa4QIvd?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho Books**

- Good value for money.
- Automated invoicing and expense management.
- Integrates with other Zoho business applications.

Best for startups and budget-conscious businesses.

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/au/books/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Reckon**

- Affordable accounting options.
- GST and bookkeeping tools.
- Suitable for smaller businesses with straightforward needs.

Best for keeping software costs down.

[Visit Reckon](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

These choices reflect current Australian comparisons and feature coverage. ## Which one would I choose?

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Sole trader | Xero or Rounded |
| Small business with employees | Xero or MYOB |
| Retail business with stock | MYOB |
| Trades or contracting | Xero or MYOB |
| Consulting or professional services | Xero |
| Very tight budget | Reckon or Zoho Books |
